source_text: In Kenya, performance targets set by donors like PEPFAR—aiming for millions of procedures annually—have incentivized mobilizers to use shaming tactics against uncircumcised males or offer extraneous perks (e.g., sodas), while rushing intake to meet quotas, resulting in abbreviated counseling and circumvention of consent protocols.
